'''Adrinne Bunt''' was married to [[Almen Bunt]].

==History==
On the day Almen married her, he planted a pair of walnut trees. She used to bake thick sourdough bread and keep count of the years for Almen.

Her death had a lasting influence on her surviving husband, Almen Bunt. She likely died only in the recent years before the [[Last Battle]], as Almen often did things out of habit as he did when Adrinne was alive.

==Trivia==
*Adrinne Bunt is named after Adrienne Hotard, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
